# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P37](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0037)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c38 P49](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0049)</sub>
- **Role:** Medical Doctor  <sub>[v4 c1 P18](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0018), [v4 c22 P27](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0027)</sub>
- **Titles:** President of the Freshman Class  <sub>[v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000)</sub>; Medalist  <sub>[v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003)</sub>; Doctor  <sub>[v4 c1 P18](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0018), [v4 c22 P27](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0027)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c25 P55](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0055)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is handsome and tall, with broad shoulders, curly brown hair, and roguish hazel eyes. He has a mouth that easily twists into a droll or teasing smile, and he carries a manly, straightforward appearance.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Gilbert is clever, ambitious, and clever-minded, holding clear thoughts about getting the best out of life. Though teasing and mischievous as a schoolboy, he is fundamentally kind-hearted, earnest, and deeply determined once his mind is made up. He possesses a strong sense of duty and stubborn conviction, even when faced with difficult decisions. He maintains high personal ideals and values genuine, deep companionship.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v2 c7 P12](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0012), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v4 c29 P37](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0037), [v4 c30 P2](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0002)_

## History

Upon returning to Avonlea school after summering in New Brunswick, Gilbert playfully teased Anne Shirley by calling her 'Carrots', causing her to smash a slate over his head and refuse to speak to him for years. Despite her persistent hostility, Gilbert maintained a good-natured academic rivalry with Anne, eventually winning the medal at Queen's Academy. Upon graduation, he surrendered his post as teacher of the Avonlea school to Anne so she could stay near Green Gables, finally establishing a warm friendship between them. While teaching at White Sands, he co-founded the Avonlea Village Improvement Society alongside Anne before both departed for Redmond College. At Redmond, he excelled academically, served as Freshman class president, and realized his deep love for Anne, though she initially rejected his proposal of marriage. Following his graduation with top honours, Gilbert nearly died of typhoid fever, which brought about a mutual realization of their true feelings. After recovering, he married Anne and relocated to Four Winds Harbor to take over the medical practice of his great-uncle, Dr. David Blythe.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003), [v1 c38 P37](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0037), [v1 c38 P50](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0050), [v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055), [v2 c1 P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c20 P41](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0041), [v3 c39 P23](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0023), [v3 c40 P9](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0009), [v4 c1 P5](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0005), [v4 c1 P18](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0018)_

## Background by volume

- Spent a summer visiting cousins in New Brunswick before returning to Avonlea school  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- Engaged in an intense academic rivalry with Anne Shirley throughout school and Queen's  <sub>[v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024)</sub>
- Won the medal at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003)</sub>
- Taught school at White Sands to earn money for college  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>
- Attended Redmond College, winning High Honors in Classics and the Cooper Prize  <sub>[v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c39 P23](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0023)</sub>
- Survived a severe bout of typhoid fever after overworking at college  <sub>[v3 c40 P9](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0009), [v3 c40 P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025)</sub>
